# Source: BigQuery's ST_CLOSESTPOINT definition (point on the first input minimizing distance).
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions#st_closestpoint

SELECT TYPEOF(ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1)))
=> "GEOGRAPHY"

SELECT ST_CLOSESTPOINT(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> null

SELECT ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null

SELECT ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> null

SELECT ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> null

SELECT ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> "POINT(0 0)"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(-10 0, 10 0)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 5)), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(-5, 0), FALSE), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(-10 0, 10 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 -10, 0 10)')), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 10 0, 0 10, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1)), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 10 0, 0 10, 0 0))')), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 10 0, 0 10, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(5, -5)), ST_GEOGPOINT(5, 0))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POINT(50 50), LINESTRING(-10 0, 10 0))'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 5)), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(SAFE.ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1)), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "true"

SELECT SAFE.ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), TRUE)
=> null

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(20 -10, 20 10)')), ST_GEOGPOINT(10, 0))
=> "true"

# Overlapping inputs may have many closest points; either geography must cover the answer.
SELECT ST_COVERS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1)'), ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 10 0, 0 10, 0 0))')))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2)), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe')), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_GEOMETRYTYPE(ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe')))
=> "ST_Point"

# Source: BigQuery answers collected by the maintainer.

SELECT ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2))
=> "POINT(1 2)"

SELECT ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "POINT(1 2)"

SELECT ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "POINT(165.46554491946 89.4081206094674)"

SELECT ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), TRUE)
=> null

SELECT ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), TRUE)
=> error: ST_ClosestPoint failed: ST_CLOSESTPOINT does not yet implement use_spheroid=true

SELECT ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(-1 0, 1 0)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "POINT(-1 0)"

SELECT ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 10 0, 0 10, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((1 1, 2 1, 1 2, 1 1))'))
=> "POINT(1 1)"

SELECT ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(-10 0, 10 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(-10 1, 10 1)'))
=> "POINT(-10 0)"

SELECT ST_CLOSESTPOINT(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 90), ST_GEOGPOINT(180, -90))
=> "POINT(0 90)"
